eligible_rule: source_step_count >= 32; observed_steps=floor(source_step_count*0.25) >= 8; target_index=uniform_indices(observed_steps,8)[-1]+1; use only action at target_index as label.
input_rule: Eight ordered observations uniformly sampled over the first floor(25%) of the episode; frozen VideoPrism features for the same 8 time indices and 3 camera views, plus the same 8-step sensor sequence.
known_prior_exploration: An earlier feasibility scan computed the target class counts for the first 3 shards (149 rows). Those rows remain in this expanded cohort. The held-out site list was selected only from source-site counts and hash; no model metrics or validation predictions were available. Treat this as development validation, not blind/sealed evaluation.
source: Google Research DROID 1.0.0 r2d2_faceblur train split, first 20 GCS shards only; train source records only
split_selection: Enumerate combinations of 3..5 sites, require held-out eligible-row fraction in [0.15,0.25], choose fraction closest to 0.20; ties by SHA256("droid-r2-site-heldout-v1|" + sorted_site_names_joined_by_pipe). No target labels used in site selection.
split_unit: top-level DROID collection site inferred as first path component after r2d2-data-full; all rows from one site assigned to one split.
task: Predict dominant signed Cartesian direction of the commanded velocity immediately after the eighth observed state.
